problems.problem: Custom manufacturing RFQ intake via a general contact form or email may require manual engineering review and quoting.
problems.label: hypothesis
problems.basis: The Contact Us page only asks for name, phone, email, and free-text message without structured CAD file upload or automated quoting fields, though actual internal quoting workflows are not visible.

existingSolutions.solution: Dedicated manufacturing ERP / job-shop quoting software
existingSolutions.addresses: Managing custom fabrication RFQs, CAD files, bill of materials, and shop floor scheduling

feasibility.explanation: No ForgeX solution is recommended because the company is outside ForgeX's target segment of residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors.

risks.description: Pursuing a custom metal fabrication and CNC job shop falls outside ForgeX's standardized home-service contractor playbooks and field-service integrations.

assumptions: The inspected pages do not publish service prices or unit values, and the business is outside ForgeX's target segment.

sourcesUsed.usedFor: Business identity, location, core manufacturing activities, existing website software stack, and contact information.
Company history, founding year, relocation to Idaho, and geographic service scope.
Contact form structure and verification of contact details.

limitations: Employee headcount is not stated on the inspected pages.
Names of owners, executives, or managers are not stated on the inspected pages.
Internal ERP, CAD/CAM, and accounting systems cannot be verified from the public website.
No licensing or registration numbers are published on the inspected pages.

qualification.rationale: Ardent Industries Inc. is a precision sheet metal fabrication, CNC machining, powder coating, and welding manufacturer serving industrial and commercial markets. It is outside ForgeX's segment of owner-led residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical home-service contractors.
